subject: Physics
standard_explanation: An electric circuit is a closed loop conducting path through which electric current flows. A battery acts as an energy source pushing electrons through wires to light a bulb.
simplified_explanation: A circuit is like a running track for electricity! The battery pushes the power through the wire to light up the bulb.
key_points: Wires create a path for current to flow.
The circuit must be closed and complete to light a bulb.

visual_scenes.title: Battery and Bulb
visual_scenes.description: A battery connected with copper wires to a small glowing bulb.
visual_scenes.caption: Step 1: The battery pushes electricity through wires.

sign_glossary.description: Two fists tap together representing positive and negative terminals.

assessment_questions.question: What happens when the circuit is complete?
assessment_questions.hint: Think about what electricity makes happen.
